Resolved by intake_queue #5 (user, 2026-10-18): Compline hymns are season-wide on TQ with wknum_mod_2 (1 = weeks I, III, V: Te lucis; 0 = weeks II, IV: Christe qui splendor), not duplicated across week epochs. TQ, not TQ-LENT, because the LH prints no Holy Week Compline hymn (index has Compline hymns only at pp4, 9, 16, 37, 51, 241-244), so Holy Week follows the same parity. Ash Wednesday-Saturday (week 0) therefore gets Christe qui splendor.
